title: Physical & Tangible Visualizations
abstract15s: Handle two models of the same dataset and compare what their shapes let you infer. The discussion asks when touch reveals a pattern that a chart hides.

priorWorks.title: Data Physicalization with Haptic Variables: Exploring Resistance and Friction
priorWorks.takeaway: Participants read physical patterns through friction and resistance. Many preferred resistance, even when task performance was similar.

priorWorks.title: From Squishing to Meaning: Exploring Data Physicalization Through Children's Embodied Experiences
priorWorks.takeaway: Children explored deformable objects to help designers understand which bodily experiences might convey data.

title: Designing with Time
abstract15s: Compare schedules that batch requests, leave gaps, or invite immediate replies. Explore whose time each design protects and who has to do the coordinating.

priorWorks.title: Circle Back Next Week: The Effect of Meeting-Free Weeks on Distributed Workers’ Unstructured Time and Attention Negotiation
priorWorks.takeaway: Workers used meeting-free weeks differently. Keeping time free still required negotiating when colleagues could ask for attention.

title: Listening Across Differences
abstract15s: Redesign a fast-moving Q&A so people can follow the speaker, read captions, and contribute at their own pace. Try the result in a small group.

priorWorks.title: SpeechCompass: Enhancing Mobile Captioning with Diarization and Directional Guidance via Multi-Microphone Localization
priorWorks.takeaway: Directional cues and speaker separation help a reader follow who is speaking in a group conversation.
